This application distributes the official, unmodified Android OpenList executable
as libopenlist.so and runs it as a separate local process when enabled.

Project and corresponding source:
https://github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList/tree/v4.2.6
https://github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList/archive/refs/tags/v4.2.6.tar.gz

Official binaries and build instructions:
https://github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList/releases/tag/v4.2.6
https://github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList/blob/v4.2.6/build.sh

Bundled OpenList web interface source:
https://github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList-Frontend
